أنتشل (form VIII)
# أَنْتَشِلُ (ʔantašilu) /ʔan.ta.ʃi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# أُنْتَشَلُ (ʔuntašalu) /ʔun.ta.ʃa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# أَنْتَشِلَ (ʔantašila) /ʔan.ta.ʃi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# أُنْتَشَلَ (ʔuntašala) /ʔun.ta.ʃa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
